Title: Germ of a big-vamp rush deck and Questions

Messages.Author: legb...@my-deja.com
Messages.Body:
The reason why we all tend to build rush decks with little vamps is that
by the time big vamps get out your average rush deck is dead already.
However, if one could slow up the other decks one would have more time,
and big vamps would then be an option. So i am toying with the idea of a
deck based on Thetmes clan-impersonating to !Toreador, getting the Art of
Pain and depravity, and wreaking Havoc in consequence. The idea is for
this deck to survive until its combo comes off through a goodly dose of
Telepathic counter/misdirection, Eagles' Sight and Millicent Smith -
little vamps with AUS being most of the rest of the crypt, obviously, and
a bit of Art Scam may well go in there for further pool gain.

The questions are, having clan-impersonated, [i] does Thetmes lose all
his contracts [i believe the answer is yes], and [ii] can he now commit
diablerie [i believe the answer is no]?

Thanks to anyone who can help me out with this; also, if anyone has built
this deck already i'd like to know about it ... don't really want to be
recreating something that is already someone else's baby!

Sent via Deja.com http://www.deja.com/
Before you buy.

In article <Pine.SOL.4.10.99101...@harper.uchicago.edu>,

> Out of curiosity, why Thetmes over Basilia and/or Samantha? Is it just one
> of those things?

Thetmes has CEL in common with the !Toreador, so can play manouevers,
additional strikes and damage prevention; but crucially because he has
pot for IG. Basilia has pot, of course, so she is an option, and in a
different kind of deck so would Lazverinus be. But Laz is dangerous,
because frequently contested. The idea in this deck is to do a large
amount of agg hand damage, and to be relatively economical in terms of
strike cards, so that there is space for the anti-bleed and vote cards
which you need to survive early in the game.

>
> (Hmm. What about Thetmes _and_ Samantha? Hmm.)
>

> wants to do a reversal of fortunes/millicent stealth/intercept deck

Phillippe Richer and Gomi [i think] had vicious Malky OOT vote decks on-
line in [AIR] jol84 and another game; Gomi's was more or less the one
Jasper discusses further down this thread, and it certainly screwed me up
good and proper.

I've done it and it works beautifully. I usually use Dramatic
Upheaval/Kindred Restructure, but I've got a few Reversals in there too.
Switching seats lets you pick up easy VPs from killing weak Meths, whereas
reversal requires you to actually kill your prey. I took Millicent out to
keep things focused. The main problems I've had are a lack of combat
defense, and a bit of trouble assuring the votes pass. I think the combat
defense wouldn't be an issue If I wasn't also doing a lot of Progeny/Embrace
in the deck too. The malks don't have a lot of votes, so you need to get
them early to stay ahead of "real" political decks. The quick votes come
from Malk Justicar, followed up with Praxis. I've also got some Command of
the Harpies, as PS votes are less likely to stay around than the votes taken
away from others are to stay gone. I don't have any Malkavian Rider Clauses,
or they would help to alleviate this, I think. My version of the deck also
loads up on Consanguinous Boons (sp?) since all your vamps are malks, and they
are coming out of the woodwork. The other advantage to using the network
with Progeny is that you can create Progeny on your turn, and they can act
on your prey's turn, getting around their little restriction.

An Ideal first few turns:
Turn 1 (4 Transfers!)
Brazil, Normal

Turn 2
Madness Network
Brazil calls Malk Justicar on himself, with 3 votes for, backed by stealth.
Normal calls PS Cleveland on himself, with 4 votes for.

Bring out Zoe, 1 to Victoria

On your prey's turn, you call Dramatic Upheaval w/Zoe, backed by stealth.
You get the next turn.

Turn 3
Feeding Ground
Progeny with Brazil
Embrace with Zoe
Bring out Victoria

On your prey's turn, you call Kindred Restructure w/Normal, backed by stealth.
Put the weakest person as your prey, and you get the next turn.
Night mission your prey with Zoe.
Hunt/bleed with Progeny.

Turn 4
Gain 3 pool from the edge.
You've got 6 active vamps:
Brazil (Justicar)
Normal (Prince)
Victoria
Zoe
Progeny
Embrace

So each Consangeuinous boon gives you 6 pool.
The rest of the game goes like this, with you following your prey around the
table, and no-one else getting a turn while your Upheavals/Restructurings hold
out. Plus, you're getting 3 pool a turn, plus 6-10 per Boon, and you're
getting more minions every turn. The only potential problem is hand jam
with stealth, but you're getting enough turns to be able to discard.

Anyway, I don't have a deck list, but I think my deck is something like:

Victoria x2
Zoe x2
Brazil
Normal x2
Dollface
Lucian
Gilbert Duane
Leandro
Greger Andersson

Master:
Madness Network x5
Auspex x3
Obfuscate x10
Asylum Hunting ground x2
Fragment

Auspex (Protect the Network):
Spirit's Touch x3
H.S. x3
Eagle's Sight x2
Telepathic Vote Counting x3

Obfuscate:
Lost in Crowds x3
Faceless Night x5
Hidden Pathways x3
Cloak the Gathering x5
Night Missions x3

Praxis Seizures x8
Malk Justicar x3 (All I have)
Command of the Harpies x3
Second Tradition x4
Dramatic Upheaval x6
Kindred Restructure x6
Consang. Boon x6
Reversal of Fortunes x2

Progeny x6
Embrace x6

I've also tried it with a splash of Presence, since I don't have enough
Telepathic Vote Countings.

Bye,
Cy Myers

The jol84 deck was made by IN...@baka.com, and used the Madness Network/
Reversal of Fortune combo, with some weenie Ventrue and Presence thrown
in for vote support. I took it over a few turns in and (once I figured
out how to use it) got 5 out of 8 VPs.

There were a huge number of votes on the table in that game, and I was able
to win only by making deals (i.e., support my Reversals of Fortune and you,
me (and the people in between us) will get to act, but your pred and my prey
won't). It was pretty close at a couple of points.
